#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <functional>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    static const int MOD = 998244353;

    void solve(istream& in, ostream& out) {
        int n;
        long long k;
        in >> n >> k;
        vector<long long> fact(n+1), inv(n+1);
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            fact[i+1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;

        inv[n] = powMod(fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD);
        for (int i = n; i > 0; --i)
            inv[i-1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;

        auto comb = [&](int i, int j) -> long long {
            return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD;
        };

        if (k == 0) {
            out << fact[n] << "\n";
        } else if (k > n) {
            out << 0 << "\n";
        } else {
            int k2 = (int)k;
            int k3 = n - k2;
            long long ans = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= k3; ++i) {
                long long tmp = comb(k3, i) * powMod(i, n, MOD) % MOD;
                if (((k3 - i) & 1) != 0) {
                    ans -= tmp;
                } else {
                    ans += tmp;
                }
            }
            ans = ((ans % MOD) + MOD) % MOD;
            ans = ans * 2 % MOD * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
            out << ans << "\n";
        }
    }

    long long powMod(long long base, long long exp, int mod) {
        long long result = 1;
        long long mul = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) result = result * mul % mod;
            mul = mul * mul % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

int main() {
    Main solution;
    solution.solve(cin, cout);
    return 0;
}
